notes: AI-assisted manual review (optional): reviewer may configure their own endpoint / model / API key, stored only in this browser's local storage. The tool stays offline by default; the opt-in version check is still read-only and multi-source, and never uploads table data. Only when the reviewer opens the AI panel for one row and clicks Send is that single row's source text, current translation and read-as string POSTed to the reviewer's own endpoint. Final answers are always chosen by the native-speaker human reviewer.
